dispatch_log.csv.reporting_unit_id: reporting unit the questionnaire was addressed to
dispatch_log.csv.enterprise_id: enterprise the reporting unit belongs to
dispatch_log.csv.reference_quarter: survey reference quarter the questionnaire relates to
dispatch_log.csv.dispatch_ts: timestamp of dispatch, minute precision, local time
dispatch_log.csv.reissue_flag: Y when the questionnaire was reissued after a reported non delivery; the row carries the reissue timestamp

receipt_log.csv.receipt_ts: timestamp of receipt, minute precision, local time

receipt_dispatch_link.csv.dispatch_id: dispatch closed by that form; a form may close several dispatches

published_mean_elapsed_times.csv.mean_elapsed_minutes: mean elapsed time in whole minutes as published in the Collection Performance Bulletin

adopted_followup_schedule_2025.csv.stratum: industry stratum code, ALL for the survey wide boundary
adopted_followup_schedule_2025.csv.reminder_day: reminder day implied by the boundary
